enactus.note: Enactus students are partner-programme guests, not employees: visuals carry the shared footer 'Energized by Each Other #OYW26' (same as every other post), and captions add #Enactus. Captions are starting points; students can edit freely in their own words and language.

posts.title: Announcement
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
I'm going to the One Young World Summit to see if something I built in a classroom can survive a conversation with Schneider Electric's engineers.

Our Enactus team started with one problem and a lot of late nights. These are people who work on real grids every day. If our design has a weak spot they'll find it in about five minutes, and I'd rather hear it from them now.

What would you ask someone who builds this for a living?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
I'm going to the One Young World Summit to find out if a small local project matters next to something built at Schneider Electric's scale.

Ours began with one community and one problem. Theirs covers whole countries. I'm curious how an idea gets from the first size to the second, and whether it always should.

I'll report back.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I'm going to the One Young World Summit to pitch my idea to a room that's heard a thousand pitches, Schneider Electric's people included.

My Enactus team has heard this pitch so many times they can recite it. The feedback I'm after now is from people who do this for a living, so I'll be looking for them.

Any advice for pitching to people who've heard it all?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I'm going to the One Young World Summit to be the only person from my university in a room this big, and bring my whole Enactus team with me anyway.

Everything I'm taking there we built together, so in a way they're coming too. Schneider Electric's team will be in that room too, and I plan to find them.

Who would you bring into a room like that?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
I'm opening Pass the Question for One Young World with the one I'm carrying to Cape Town: can something I built in a classroom actually survive contact with a real client?

I'll ask the Schneider Electric engineers I meet how they found out themselves. They all had a first client at some point.

If you've been through it, tell me how it went.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
I'm opening Pass the Question for One Young World with this: does a small local project matter at all next to something built at Schneider Electric's scale?

My plan is to walk up to the Schneider Electric booth and ask the people there whether they remember their first small idea. I think most of them will.

What was yours?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
My question to open Pass the Question for One Young World: how do you pitch an idea to someone who's heard a thousand pitches before?

I'm pitching mine anyway, nerves and all. I've heard the Schneider Electric team likes meeting students at the Summit. I hope they catch me mid-pitch, because I'm better out loud than on paper.

What's the best pitch advice you ever got?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I'm opening Pass the Question for One Young World with the thing I keep wondering about: what does it actually feel like to be the only person from your university in a room this big?

I'm bringing my whole team with me, so at least I won't find out alone. I'll also be looking for the Schneider Electric team, since they're the people there I already know I can ask.

Have you ever been the only one in the room?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: On-Site Moment
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
The badge scanner beeped, and just like that I was in the same room as the Schneider Electric engineers who work on continental-scale grids.

A few weeks ago this was a classroom project. Today I asked one of them how they'd stress-test it and got a straight answer.

One Young World, Cape Town. I'm still a bit stunned.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
Someone twice my age, from the Schneider Electric booth, asked me a follow-up question about my own project. I wasn't ready for that.

I'd gone over to ask them things. I ended up explaining our budget. Being taken seriously before you feel ready is a strange feeling, and I recommend it.

That's my One Young World so far.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I counted six languages at my lunch table before anyone switched to English for my benefit.

Two of the people at the table work at Schneider Electric. They switch languages across borders every day without thinking about it. I had to think about it a lot.

Lunch at One Young World is its own session.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
A speaker stopped her own presentation because someone in the crowd raised a hand. The question turned out better than the slide.

I would have panicked and kept going. She listened and went with it. An hour later I saw the same thing at the Schneider Electric booth, where the people behind the table were asking more questions than they answered.

Noted for my next pitch.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Reflection
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
I came in thinking the hard part was the pitch. I left knowing the hard part is doing it again on Monday, without an audience.

A Schneider Electric engineer in Cape Town told me most of the work is the part nobody watches. I'm bringing that home to my Enactus team, along with a long to-do list.

What's your Monday commitment?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
One habit, starting now: ask the question in the room. A Schneider Electric engineer showed me why, in one conversation.

I nearly kept my question for after the session. I asked it on the spot, got an answer in two minutes, and got three better questions back from the same engineer. My Enactus team is going to hear about this until they're tired of it.

What question have you been saving for later?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I used to think 'professional' meant polished. Now I think it means showing up prepared to be wrong in public.

The best pitch I saw at One Young World stopped halfway so the speaker could fix a number someone in the audience had corrected. Nobody minded, and the Schneider Electric people sitting near me were nodding.

What did you have to unlearn?

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
The idea I came with is smaller than the one I left with, and the Schneider Electric people I met are the reason.

They kept asking what it would look like at ten times the size. I had no answer at the start of the week and half of one by the end. My Enactus team and I have something to finish first.

#EnergizedByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

archetypes.blurb: First role after university, still learning how the work really gets done.

archetypes.name: The Remote / Field Hire

archetypes.blurb: You came to Schneider from another path and see things differently.

archetypes.name: The Early Achiever
archetypes.blurb: You already lead something and want to measure it against the world.

A.caption:
I'm taking a question to One Young World: how long until I stop double-checking everything before I send it to my manager?

I'm a year into my first job at Schneider Electric and I still read every email twice. With 190 countries in one room, I can ask people who've been exactly where I am. I suspect some of them will tell me they never stopped.

I'm joining the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. What would you tell first-year you?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
The question I've carried all year: how do you make your work visible when you're not in the room?

I'm based a long way from the main office. Most of my Schneider Electric colleagues know me as a name at the bottom of a report. In Cape Town I'll finally be in the room with colleagues who have only ever read my work.

This is my card in the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. If you work remotely, how do you handle it?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I switched industries to be here. How do I make the most of my first year?

At One Young World I'm asking people who made the same switch and stayed at Schneider Electric. Mostly I want to know what they did in their first year that they would do again.

I'm adding this to the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. If you've switched careers, I'm listening.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
How do you tell the difference between being ready for more responsibility and just being impatient?

I can't tell from the inside. So at One Young World I'm asking Schneider Electric colleagues who got more responsibility early how they knew.

I'm in the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. How did you know?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
Dear Day-One Me, stop rehearsing your questions in the elevator. Just ask them in the room.

I once rehearsed a question for three floors and then didn't ask it. A year in at Schneider Electric, most of what I know came from the questions I did ask, and nobody made me feel bad for any of them.

What would you tell yourself on day one?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
Dear Day-One Me, the imposter feeling doesn't go away by month three. It just gets quieter.

I kept waiting for a morning when it would be gone. What helped was hearing people ten years ahead of me at Schneider Electric say they still get it.

What would your letter say?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
Dear Day-One Me, you picked the right place to start. Nobody expects you to know everything. They just want to know you'll ask.

I spent my first weeks at Schneider Electric hiding what I didn't know from people who were waiting to explain it. I'd like those weeks back.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
Dear Day-One Me, you're going to mess up a deliverable in your first quarter. It's fine. It's actually fine.

Mine was a spreadsheet, and it went to more people than I'd like to admit. My manager at Schneider Electric helped me fix it and didn't fix it for me. I learned more that week than in the good ones.

What was your first mistake at work?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
First global summit. First time realizing 'international team' meant something bigger than my inbox.

I've emailed Schneider Electric colleagues in a dozen countries this year. This week at One Young World I'm meeting some of them, and a few are nothing like their email signatures.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
First time in a room with 190 countries, and the only thing louder than the languages was how much everyone had to say.

I'm spending my breaks at the Schneider Electric booth. People walk up with questions in every accent, and after one year I can answer more of them than I thought I could.

Cape Town, One Young World.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I came in expecting to feel small. I'm starting to understand the size of what Schneider Electric is part of.

My job is one small piece of the energy system. This week delegates are telling me what that system means where they live, and my piece makes more sense.

That's One Young World so far.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
First time in a room this big, and the first time a stranger who stopped by the Schneider Electric booth remembered my name an hour later.

A year ago I was writing my thesis. Now I'm explaining my job to people from countries I've never been to, and they ask good questions.

What was your first time in a room like this?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
I'm not in Cape Town this week, but my question is. I asked our Schneider Electric delegates at One Young World whether it's actually as overwhelming as it looks online.

The reply: "More. In the best way. Bring comfortable shoes and a notes app."

Both cards are in the post. What would you ask someone at the Summit?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
I couldn't go to One Young World, so I sent a question with a colleague who did: did you meet anyone from our old university team?

Three people, apparently. They found our delegate at the Schneider Electric booth within the first hour, which sounds about right for that group.

Swipe for the answer as it came in.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
My question for our delegates at One Young World was which session they wish the whole team could see.

They said the hallway conversations between sessions, because that's where the real stuff happens. I've asked them to bring a few of those back to our next Schneider Electric team meeting, and I'm holding them to it.

The full exchange is on the cards.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I asked our delegates in Cape Town to be honest: are you nervous?

"Constantly. Also completely fine. The Schneider Electric people here make it easy to be both."

That sounds like the team I know. Swipe to read it, then tell me what you'd ask.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
I used to think my role was to execute the plan. Now I think it's to ask better questions about the plan.

One Young World did that. I'm going into my second year at Schneider Electric and I'd like it to have more questions in it than the first.

What would you change about how you work, starting Monday?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
The scene that did it: watching a senior Schneider Electric engineer admit, in front of everyone, that she didn't know the answer either.

Nobody in the room thought less of her. I've been treating "I don't know" as something to hide, and she said it into a microphone.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I'm starting next week by asking my manager for one thing I never thought to ask for: more context, not more tasks.

In Cape Town I saw where Schneider Electric's work ends up, in places I had only seen on a slide. I want to know the why behind my part of it.

That's my one commitment after One Young World. What's yours?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I came back smaller in the org chart and bigger in how much I believe I can change at Schneider Electric.

Nobody at One Young World asked for my job title. They asked what I was working on, and then what I'd do differently. I had answers.

What would you change if you knew you could?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm heading to Cape Town next month for One Young World, and I'm taking one question with me.

I lead the mobility segment in Côte d'Ivoire. More of how our cities move now runs on AI, and the grid behind it gets smarter every year. What I can't answer yet is who gets trained to run it.

I'll spend the week listening to people from 190 countries. Look for me around the Schneider Electric booth between sessions. If you're going too, come and say hello.

What should I ask while I'm there?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pars au Cap le mois prochain pour One Young World, avec une question en tête.

Je dirige le segment mobilité en Côte d'Ivoire. La mobilité dans nos villes repose de plus en plus sur l'IA, et le réseau électrique qui l'alimente devient plus intelligent chaque année. Ce que je ne sais pas encore, c'est qui sera formé pour l'exploiter.

Je vais à la rencontre de participants venus de 190 pays pour écouter, apprendre et échanger autour de ces enjeux. Vous me trouverez du côté du stand Schneider Electric entre deux sessions. Si vous êtes aussi du voyage, passez me saluer.

Quelle question devrais-je poser là-bas ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Chain start (Intelligent Jobs) -> passes to LaFortune Ngakam

EN.caption:
My turn in Pass the Question. The one I've had in mind: how do you get a team to see AI as a decision aid, not just a dashboard?

What I've seen work is training people for the jobs AI creates, and not stopping at supervising the ones it changes. On the Schneider Electric projects I've been part of, trust showed up once people had their hands on the tools.

That left me with a new question, and it goes to @LaFortune Ngakam: how do you build that trust before the tools even reach people?

It's on the second card. I'd like to read your answers too.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
C'est mon tour dans Pass the Question. La question que j'avais en tête : comment amener une équipe à considérer l'IA comme une aide à la décision, et non comme un simple tableau de bord ?

Ce que j'ai vu fonctionner, c'est de former les gens aux métiers que l'IA crée, sans s'arrêter à la supervision de ceux qu'elle transforme. Sur les projets Schneider Electric auxquels j'ai participé, la confiance est venue quand les équipes ont eu les outils en main.

Cela m'amène à une nouvelle question, que je passe à @LaFortune Ngakam : comment instaurer cette confiance avant même que les outils n'arrivent jusqu'aux gens ?

Elle est sur la deuxième carte. Vos réponses m'intéressent aussi.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Last month a client asked me who would run the smart system I'd just sold them. I didn't have a good answer yet.

I still think about it. At Schneider Electric in Côte d'Ivoire I watch new technology arrive faster than the skills to run it. The equipment usually turns up before anyone has been trained on it.

I'm taking the question to One Young World in Cape Town in under two weeks.

Who taught you the job you do today?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Le mois dernier, un client m'a demandé qui allait faire fonctionner le système intelligent que je venais de lui vendre. Je n'avais pas encore de bonne réponse.

J'y pense encore. Chez Schneider Electric en Côte d'Ivoire, je vois les nouvelles technologies arriver plus vite que les compétences pour les faire fonctionner. Le matériel arrive souvent avant que quiconque ait été formé pour s'en servir.

J'emporte la question à One Young World, au Cap, dans moins de deux semaines.

Qui vous a appris le métier que vous exercez aujourd'hui ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Writing this from One Young World in Cape Town.

I'm walking every hallway here looking for that answer: who gets trained to run what we're building. Some of the sharpest replies have come from the youngest people in the room. I hope a few of them look up Schneider Electric after this week.

Back to the sessions.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je vous écris de One Young World, au Cap.

Ici, je parcours chaque couloir à la recherche de cette réponse : qui sera formé pour faire fonctionner ce que nous construisons. Certaines des réponses les plus justes viennent des plus jeunes de la salle. J'espère que quelques-uns s'intéresseront à Schneider Electric après cette semaine.

Je retourne aux sessions.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm back from Cape Town without a certificate. What I have is a pilot to propose at Schneider Electric.

The idea is small on purpose. Two junior engineers on our team, working hands-on with live AI tools, starting in December if it's approved. I went to ask who gets trained to run the grid we're building, and the best answer I heard was to train them inside the work.

Thank you to the delegates who argued with me all week.

What's the first thing you'd teach a junior engineer about AI?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je rentre du Cap sans certificat. Ce que j'ai, c'est un projet pilote à proposer chez Schneider Electric.

L'idée est volontairement modeste. Deux jeunes ingénieurs de notre équipe, sur des outils d'IA en conditions réelles, dès décembre si le projet est validé. J'étais parti demander qui serait formé pour exploiter le réseau que nous construisons, et la meilleure réponse que j'ai entendue, c'est de les former sur le terrain.

Merci aux délégués qui ont débattu avec moi toute la semaine.

Quelle est la première chose que vous apprendriez à un jeune ingénieur sur l'IA ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Cape Town next month, for One Young World. My question is about distance.

I work in sales distribution for Schneider Electric in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire. In practice that means getting energy technology to the places that need it, and most of those places are a long way from a capital city. People talk about the African Century as if it's already settled. I want to know what it means while the last mile still isn't solved.

I'll come back with whatever I can use.

Where does the last mile start for you?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Le Cap le mois prochain, pour One Young World. Ma question porte sur la distance.

Je travaille dans la distribution chez Schneider Electric, au Sénégal et en Côte d'Ivoire. Concrètement, il s'agit de faire arriver nos solutions énergétiques là où on en a besoin, et la plupart de ces endroits sont loin d'une capitale. On parle du Siècle Africain comme s'il était déjà acquis. Je veux savoir ce qu'il signifie tant que la question du dernier kilomètre n'est pas réglée.

Je reviendrai avec tout ce qui peut nous servir.

Pour vous, où commence le dernier kilomètre ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Chain start (Future of Africa) -> passes to Ibtissam Adaha

EN.caption:
Pass the Question, and this is the one I've been carrying: what do you do when "available in Africa" really just means "available in the capital"?

My answer is to price access for the last mile, not just the easiest one. I hold my own work at Schneider Electric to that. If a product stops at the city limits, I haven't done my job.

Which leaves a question I can't answer alone. @Ibtissam Adaha, who decides which projects even get built out that far?

It's on the second card.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Pass the Question, et voici la question que je porte depuis longtemps : que faire quand « disponible en Afrique » signifie en réalité « disponible dans la capitale » ?

Ma réponse : tarifer l'accès pour le dernier kilomètre, pas seulement pour le plus facile. C'est l'exigence que je m'impose chez Schneider Electric. Si un produit s'arrête aux portes de la ville, je n'ai pas fait mon travail.

Il reste une question à laquelle je ne peux pas répondre seule. @Ibtissam Adaha, qui décide quels projets vont aussi loin ?

Elle est sur la deuxième carte.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
A distributor once told me our product "existed" in his country. It just wasn't anywhere he could actually reach it.

He was right, and I've thought about distribution differently since. Being on a price list and being within reach are two separate things. Closing that distance is most of what I do at Schneider Electric, and it's the part of the job I'd pick again.

I'm bringing his sentence with me to One Young World in Cape Town.

What's available where you live but still out of reach?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Un distributeur m'a dit un jour que notre produit « existait » dans son pays. Sauf qu'il n'y avait aucun endroit où il pouvait réellement se le procurer.

Il avait raison, et je vois la distribution autrement depuis. Figurer sur une liste de prix et être à portée de main sont deux choses différentes. Réduire cette distance, c'est l'essentiel de mon travail chez Schneider Electric, et c'est la partie du métier que je choisirais à nouveau.

J'emporte sa phrase avec moi à One Young World, au Cap.

Qu'est-ce qui est disponible chez vous, mais reste hors de portée ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm asking everyone who stops by the Schneider Electric booth the same question: what does "available" cost once you leave the capital? This morning a delegate from the other side of the continent described my exact problem back to me, with different town names.

If you're at One Young World this week, come and answer it too.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pose la même question à tous ceux qui passent au stand Schneider Electric : combien coûte « disponible » une fois qu'on quitte la capitale ? Ce matin, un délégué venu de l'autre bout du continent m'a décrit exactement mon problème, avec d'autres noms de villes.

Si vous êtes à One Young World cette semaine, venez y répondre aussi.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
One Young World is over and I have homework.

This month I'm sharing three takeaways with my distribution partners, starting with how we price access, not just product. I left for Cape Town asking what the African Century means if the last mile isn't solved. I came back thinking it starts with who can reach what we sell.

If you work in distribution somewhere on the continent, at Schneider Electric or anywhere else, I'd like to compare notes. My inbox is open.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
One Young World est terminé et j'ai des devoirs à faire.

Ce mois-ci, je partage trois enseignements avec mes partenaires distributeurs, en commençant par notre façon de tarifer l'accès, et pas seulement le produit. J'étais partie au Cap en demandant ce que signifie le Siècle Africain si la question du dernier kilomètre n'est pas réglée. Je reviens avec l'idée que tout commence par une question : qui a réellement accès à ce que nous vendons ?

Si vous travaillez dans la distribution quelque part sur le continent, chez Schneider Electric ou ailleurs, j'aimerais comparer nos expériences. Écrivez-moi.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World.

As Tendering Leader in Morocco, I see how large infrastructure decisions get made and what they end up rewarding. A tender decides what gets built and who builds it. My question for the Summit is what the next generation of tenders should actually reward.

I'll be around the Schneider Electric booth most days. If you have an opinion on how projects get awarded, bring it.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pars au Cap pour One Young World.

En tant que Tendering Leader au Maroc, je vois comment se prennent les grandes décisions d'infrastructure, et ce qu'elles finissent par récompenser. Un appel d'offres décide de ce qui se construit et de qui le construit. Ma question pour le Sommet : que devrait réellement récompenser la prochaine génération d'appels d'offres ?

Je serai presque tous les jours du côté du stand Schneider Electric. Si vous avez un avis sur la façon dont les projets sont attribués, venez me le donner.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
@Ndiaye Dielya passed me a question that is more or less my job description: who decides which projects get built out to the places that need them most?

I'd rewrite the tender criteria so local capability beats the lowest price. In the bids I prepare at Schneider Electric, I've started asking what we leave behind besides the equipment.

My new question goes to @Lina Djellouli. Once the criteria are right, who will actually deliver on them?

Swipe for the second card.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
@Ndiaye Dielya m'a passé une question qui résume à peu près mon métier : qui décide quels projets arrivent jusqu'aux endroits qui en ont le plus besoin ?

Je réécrirais les critères d'attribution pour que les compétences locales l'emportent sur le prix le plus bas. Dans les offres que je prépare chez Schneider Electric, je me demande désormais ce que nous laissons derrière nous, en plus de l'équipement.

Ma nouvelle question est pour @Lina Djellouli. Une fois les bons critères en place, qui portera concrètement la réalisation de ces avancées ?

Faites défiler pour voir la deuxième carte.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I once watched a stronger local bid lose to a cheaper one that never trained a single local hire.

It stayed with me. In my work at Schneider Electric in Morocco, I've read tenders differently since. They look like paperwork, and they decide who gets a chance to build.

What should a winning bid have to prove? I'm taking that to One Young World.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
J'ai vu une offre locale plus solide perdre face à une offre moins chère qui n'a jamais formé un seul employé local.

Cela m'est resté. Dans mon travail chez Schneider Electric au Maroc, je lis les appels d'offres autrement depuis. On dirait de la paperasse, et pourtant ils décident de qui a une chance de construire.

Que devrait prouver une offre gagnante ? J'emporte cette question à One Young World.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Cape Town, in the middle of One Young World.

I'm here comparing notes on tender criteria that finally reward the bid that builds people, not just projects. About half of those conversations began with someone stopping at the Schneider Electric booth to tell me I was wrong. I learned the most from those.

Have you seen a project that built skills as well as infrastructure? I'm collecting examples.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Le Cap, en plein One Young World.

Ici, j'échange sur les critères d'attribution qui récompensent enfin l'offre qui forme des gens, et pas seulement celle qui livre un projet. Environ la moitié de ces conversations ont commencé quand quelqu'un s'est arrêté au stand Schneider Electric pour me dire que j'avais tort. Ce sont celles qui m'ont le plus appris.

Avez-vous vu un projet qui a développé des compétences autant que des infrastructures ? Je rassemble des exemples.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I came back from One Young World with one new filter.

I'm reviewing our next three tender templates and asking the same thing of each: local capability, or just delivery? It sounds simple written down. It's less simple with a deadline on the table.

In Cape Town I heard "the African Century" used as a target people could be held to, and it changed how I see my part in it. If this is the kind of work you want to do, we do a lot of it at Schneider Electric.

What would you add to the filter?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je suis rentrée de One Young World avec un nouveau filtre.

Je revois nos trois prochains modèles d'appel d'offres en posant la même question pour chacun : développer les compétences locales, ou seulement livrer ? Écrit comme ça, c'est simple. Ça l'est moins avec une échéance sur la table.

Au Cap, j'ai entendu parler du Siècle Africain comme d'un objectif sur lequel on peut rendre des comptes, et cela a changé ma façon de voir mon rôle. Si c'est le genre de travail qui vous attire, nous en faisons beaucoup chez Schneider Electric.

Qu'ajouteriez-vous à ce filtre ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I have one question for One Young World in Cape Town. Intelligent jobs sounds great, but intelligent for who?

I manage digital services offers for Cameroon and Morocco, and my own career at Schneider Electric has run between those two countries. Along the way I've met brilliant people who simply never got the tools.

I want to see how others are closing that gap.

Which skill do you wish you'd had access to earlier?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
J'ai une question pour One Young World, au Cap. Les emplois intelligents, ça sonne bien, mais intelligents pour qui ?

Je gère des offres de services digitaux pour le Cameroun et le Maroc, et ma propre carrière chez Schneider Electric s'est construite entre ces deux pays. En chemin, j'ai rencontré des personnes brillantes qui n'ont tout simplement jamais eu les outils.

Je veux voir comment d'autres comblent cet écart.

Quelle compétence auriez-vous aimé pouvoir développer plus tôt ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Bakayoko Guefa -> passes to Rezolia Muller-Potluri

EN.caption:
@Bakayoko Guefa handed me this one: how do you build trust in AI before the tools even reach people?

Open access before anyone has to ask for it. I've watched good engineers wait months for hands-on time, and by then they had already decided the tools weren't for them. I make this case at Schneider Electric every time we plan a rollout.

Next question, for @Rezolia Muller-Potluri: what about the roles that get automated before access ever arrives?

The full exchange is on the cards.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
@Bakayoko Guefa m'a transmis cette question : comment instaurer la confiance en l'IA avant même que les outils n'arrivent jusqu'aux gens ?

Ouvrir l'accès avant que quiconque ait à le demander. J'ai vu de bons ingénieurs attendre des mois avant de pouvoir toucher aux outils, et entre-temps ils avaient conclu que ce n'était pas pour eux. C'est ce que je défends chez Schneider Electric à chaque fois que nous préparons un déploiement.

Question suivante, pour @Rezolia Muller-Potluri : que deviennent les postes automatisés avant même que cet accès n'arrive ?

L'échange complet est sur les cartes.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I once watched a brilliant engineer sit out an AI rollout because nobody thought to hand her the login.

She would have been the best person in the room. Since then, on every digital services offer I build at Schneider Electric for Cameroon and Morocco, the access list is the first thing I ask about.

Who handed you your first real opportunity?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
J'ai vu une ingénieure brillante rester à l'écart d'un déploiement d'IA parce que personne n'avait pensé à lui donner les accès.

Elle aurait été la plus compétente de l'équipe. Depuis, pour chaque offre de services digitaux que je conçois chez Schneider Electric pour le Cameroun et le Maroc, la liste des accès est la première chose que je demande.

Qui vous a donné votre première vraie opportunité ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Here in Cape Town, I'm asking every founder I meet: who gets the login first, and who decides?

The answers vary more than I expected, and people are being honest about it. A few of them think about access the way my team at Schneider Electric does. I hope they stay in touch.

In your team, who decides who gets the new tools?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Ici, au Cap, je demande à chaque fondateur que je rencontre : qui obtient l'accès en premier, et qui en décide ?

Les réponses varient plus que je ne le pensais, et les gens sont francs. Quelques-uns abordent l'accès comme le fait mon équipe chez Schneider Electric. J'espère qu'ils garderont le contact.

Dans votre équipe, qui décide de l'accès aux nouveaux outils ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I went to Cape Town asking who intelligent jobs are intelligent for. I've come back with three things to test.

They're AI-readiness ideas, and I'd like to pilot them with our team in Cameroon. Hands-on time with the tools is what has been missing, so the pilots start with that.

I'd like colleagues in other markets to join. If you're at Schneider Electric and want your team involved, message me.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je suis partie au Cap en demandant pour qui les emplois intelligents sont intelligents. Je reviens avec trois choses à tester.

Ce sont des idées de préparation à l'IA, que j'aimerais tester avec notre équipe au Cameroun. Ce qui manquait, c'est du temps de pratique sur les outils, et les projets pilotes commencent par là.

J'aimerais que des collègues d'autres marchés nous rejoignent. Si vous êtes chez Schneider Electric et que vous voulez y associer votre équipe, écrivez-moi.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World to argue that the African Century starts in the panel room, not the boardroom.

I work in Panel Builder Sales at Schneider Electric in Algeria. My clients build the boards that keep the power on, and almost nobody thinks about that work until the lights go out. Every large ambition I hear about depends on it anyway.

So I'm going to make sure someone says it out loud.

Who does the unseen work in your industry?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pars au Cap pour One Young World avec une idée à défendre : le Siècle Africain commence dans l'atelier du tableautier, pas dans la salle du conseil.

Je travaille dans la vente aux tableautiers chez Schneider Electric en Algérie. Mes clients fabriquent les tableaux qui gardent la lumière allumée, et presque personne ne pense à ce travail avant la coupure. Toutes les grandes ambitions dont j'entends parler en dépendent pourtant.

Je vais donc m'assurer que quelqu'un le dise à voix haute.

Qui fait le travail de l'ombre dans votre secteur ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Ibtissam Adaha -> passes to Makwana Kamogelo

EN.caption:
@Ibtissam Adaha passed me a question I've wanted someone to ask for years: once the criteria are right, who will actually deliver on them?

The people nobody sees. Reliable power is the prerequisite everyone forgets to thank, and my job at Schneider Electric puts me next to the people who deliver it. I'm proud of that.

For @Makwana Kamogelo: if reliability is the real prerequisite, who has to prove it first?

Have a look at the second card.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
@Ibtissam Adaha m'a passé une question que j'attendais depuis des années : une fois les bons critères en place, qui portera concrètement la réalisation de ces avancées ?

Ceux que personne ne voit. Une électricité fiable est le prérequis que tout le monde oublie de remercier, et mon métier chez Schneider Electric me place aux côtés de ceux qui la fournissent. J'en suis fière.

Pour @Makwana Kamogelo : si la fiabilité est le vrai prérequis, qui doit en faire la preuve en premier ?

Jetez un œil à la deuxième carte.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Nobody thanks the panel builder until the lights go out. I've made peace with the invisible part of this job.

It took a while. I spend my days at Schneider Electric in Algeria with people whose work only gets noticed when it stops, and I used to mind that on their behalf. Now it's a big part of why I've stayed.

In a way I'm bringing them with me to One Young World in Cape Town.

Whose invisible work do you rely on every day?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Personne ne remercie le tableautier tant que le courant n'est pas coupé. J'ai fait la paix avec la part invisible de ce métier.

Il m'a fallu du temps. Chez Schneider Electric en Algérie, je passe mes journées avec des gens dont on ne remarque le travail que lorsqu'il s'arrête, et cela me dérangeait pour eux. Aujourd'hui, c'est en grande partie pour cela que je suis restée.

D'une certaine façon, je les emmène avec moi à One Young World, au Cap.

De quel travail invisible dépendez-vous chaque jour ?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm meeting the other invisible people of this industry here in Cape Town, and comparing notes on being proud of it anyway.

A lot of them have found their way to the Schneider Electric booth. The unglamorous work sounds the same in every country I've heard from so far.

Tag someone whose work keeps things running behind the scenes.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je rencontre ici, au Cap, les autres invisibles de notre secteur, et nous échangeons sur nos façons d'en être fiers malgré tout.

Beaucoup ont fini par passer au stand Schneider Electric. Le travail ingrat se raconte de la même façon, quel que soit le pays de la personne qui m'en parle.

Identifiez quelqu'un dont le travail fait tourner les choses en coulisses.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Back at Schneider Electric after One Young World, and I'm pitching a different client conversation.

It starts with what reliable distribution unlocks for a community, and gets to "buy our panels" later. I said before the Summit that reliable power is the prerequisite everyone forgets. In Cape Town nobody disagreed, and I realised I had never opened a client meeting with it.

I will now. Thanks to everyone who argued with me about panels all week.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
De retour chez Schneider Electric après One Young World, je propose une nouvelle conversation à mes clients.

Elle commence par ce qu'une distribution électrique fiable rend possible pour une communauté, et n'arrive à « achetez nos tableaux » que plus tard. J'avais dit avant le Sommet qu'une électricité fiable est le prérequis que tout le monde oublie. Au Cap, personne ne m'a contredite, et je me suis rendu compte que je n'avais jamais ouvert une réunion client là-dessus.

Je vais le faire désormais. Merci à tous ceux qui ont débattu de tableaux avec moi toute la semaine.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
One Young World is coming to Cape Town this year, which makes it personal for me.

I'm a Power Product Offer Manager in South Africa. When you host, people ask about your own country's infrastructure, and I'd rather answer for it than talk around it. I expect to learn as much from the questions as from the sessions.

Welcome to South Africa, everyone. Look for me around the Schneider Electric booth. I'm happy to recommend where to eat.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Lina Djellouli -> passes to Grace Olorunsola

EN.caption:
@Lina Djellouli sent me a question that lands close to home: if reliability is the real prerequisite for the African Century, who has to prove it first?

The host should be judged hardest. Our own grid has to earn the platform we're standing on this November, and that includes the products my team at Schneider Electric puts into it.

So here's mine for @Grace Olorunsola. Proving it to other countries is one thing. What about proving it inside our own?

Card two has the rest.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

Hosting this summit means our own grid gets compared to everyone else's, whether we're ready or not.

I'm fine with that. At Schneider Electric in South Africa, I'd rather hear the comparison from a delegate in person than read it in a report a year later. People from across the continent will ask things we've stopped asking ourselves.

One Young World gets to Cape Town next week. Bring your questions.

What would you compare with South Africa?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

One Young World, on home ground.

I'm answering that comparison in real time at the Schneider Electric booth, one delegate's question about our power mix at a time. I've been asked things about my own market this week that I had to go and look up.

What would you ask a host country?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

Having One Young World in South Africa meant a lot of delegates asking how our power products compare with what they use at home. I enjoyed that more than I expected to.

I wrote the questions down, and I'm turning every one of them into a gap analysis for our product team at Schneider Electric. It's a useful outside view and I'm passing all of it on.

If you asked me one of those questions, stay in touch. I'll tell you what we did with it.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm off to One Young World in Cape Town to ask if the African Century reaches people's homes, or just their cities' skylines.

I'm Home & Distribution Offer Manager at Schneider Electric in Nigeria, so I think about energy one household at a time. A switch a family can reach tells me more than a new tower does.

I'll be listening to delegates from 190 countries for ideas that start at home.

What does progress look like in your house?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Makwana Kamogelo -> passes to First-year graduates

EN.caption:
@Makwana Kamogelo asked me what proving the African Century actually looks like inside our own countries, not just to outsiders.

Measure it at the household, not the skyline. That's where it gets won or lost.

My question goes to our first-year graduates at Schneider Electric, since they'll be answering it long after I do: does the African Century arrive when the cities change, or when the homes do?

Second card. Over to you.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I've sat in enough planning meetings where "access" meant a substation on a map, never a switch in someone's kitchen.

The map is usually right and the kitchen is still dark. So when a product decision comes up at Schneider Electric in Nigeria, I ask where the family is in it. Sometimes that slows the meeting down.

Where do you think progress should be measured? I'm taking that to One Young World.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm listening here for the first plenary that measures progress at the kitchen switch, not the skyline.

I haven't heard it yet. In the meantime I'm at the Schneider Electric booth between sessions, asking delegates what the switch in their own kitchen looks like. The answers are better than the slides.

What tells you a place has real access?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

One new line for every project brief: does this reach the household, or just the neighbourhood?

That's what I brought back from One Young World. I went to Cape Town asking whether the African Century reaches people's homes, and I came back wanting our briefs to treat the home as part of the infrastructure.

I'm adding that line to my team's brief template at Schneider Electric this month. If you have a better one, send it to me.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm bringing a question from work to One Young World in Cape Town.

I lead microgrid projects at Schneider Electric from South Africa. In almost every design there's a point where the smartest technical choice and the best outcome for local jobs pull apart. So I want to ask whether AI-run microgrids grow local jobs, or just build smarter infrastructure with fewer people around it.

I don't know the answer. Where do you land?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question

EN.caption:
@LaFortune Ngakam passed me one I run into on every microgrid: what happens to the roles that get automated before access ever arrives?

Design the human role into the system on day one. Defending it after the system is live is too late. That's the brief my own team at Schneider Electric gets from me.

Which brings me to @Tshamano Khumbudzo. How do you promise that to a client before you've even sold them the system?

Swipe to see it.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I designed a microgrid so efficient it barely needed anyone to run it. Efficient isn't the same as right.

I was proud of that design for about a week. Then someone asked me who would work there. I'm glad that at Schneider Electric I can raise that in a design review.

When has efficient been the wrong answer in your work?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm collecting every story here about a job an algorithm almost erased, and who fought to redesign it in.

There are more of them at One Young World than I expected. In each case someone decided to keep the job. Those are the people I'd want to design microgrids with at Schneider Electric.

If you have a story like that, I want to hear it.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I went to One Young World asking whether AI-run microgrids grow local jobs or just need fewer people.

What I'm doing about it: proposing a mandatory local operations role, written into the design phase and not added after handover. In my experience, jobs that aren't designed in at the start rarely appear later.

It's a draft, and I'm looking for Schneider Electric colleagues to co-write it. Message me if that's you.

Should local jobs be a design requirement?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm going to One Young World in Cape Town with one thing to ask: what does "intelligent jobs" actually promise the people doing the work today?

I lead Digital Automation Sales in South Africa. Some of the teams I've sold to were afraid of automation and some badly needed it. The technology was the easy part both times.

I'll be around the Schneider Electric booth, happy to have this argument with anyone. Come and have it with me.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Pass the Question
posts.tag: @Schneider Electric  @One Young World  + the person named in the caption
posts.chain: question from Rezolia Muller-Potluri -> passes to First-year graduates

EN.caption:
@Rezolia Muller-Potluri gave me a question from my own day job: how do you promise a reskilling commitment before you've even sold the client the system?

Put it in the pitch, not the fine print. If the client can hold you to it before they sign, it counts.

I'm passing the next one to our first-year graduates at Schneider Electric, because they'll live with whatever we decide. Which comes first at your company: the AI, or the people it's meant to serve?

Swipe for the card.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A client once thanked me for automation, then quietly asked what happens to his team. I never forgot the pause.

I had the product answer ready and nothing else. I've sold automation at Schneider Electric in South Africa for long enough to know the product answer wasn't what he was asking for.

That pause is coming with me to One Young World in Cape Town.

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

I'm bringing that pause into every conversation here, until reskilling stops being the afterthought in the pitch.

At One Young World the people with the best answers have been on both sides. They've automated a team, and they've been on one. I'm taking notes for the next Schneider Electric pitch I write.

What should every automation pitch include?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

Before One Young World I asked what intelligent jobs promise the people doing the work.

My answer is a reskilling commitment in every pitch, not just a product spec. I went in thinking one line in the pitch was enough. I came back wanting a name and a date next to it.

I'm raising it in the next proposal I write at Schneider Electric, early, where the client can see it.

What would a real reskilling promise look like to you?

#EnergizedByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26
